title: Exact calculation resources
help: Each scalar operation shares these limits across parsing, unit conversion, arithmetic and formatting. Source and storage waits do not consume arithmetic time. Results stay exact; a limit stops preparation without rounding.
legacy: Saving a policy creates a new graph revision. Earlier revisions keep their original calculation behavior.
codec: Declared domain codecs keep their own component capacities.
invalid: Choose a whole number within each displayed range.
incomplete: Preview shows the first characters. Open the retained value to inspect or export it completely.
